title: Passover 2025 #IUIC #Bishop #Nathanyel7 #IsraelUnitedInChrist
segments: Hey, shalom officer Micah. Quick
question for you. It's Passover 2025.
What do you look forward to the most
about Passover every year? What I look
forward to most is the bishops going
into the plagues, bringing back into
remembrance, the things that our
forefathers went through and what God
commanded us to do. And now today, what
we doing is Judges 5:11. We rehearsing
the righteous act. So every time we come
together, there's newer people that had
never celebrated Passover. Like for
instance, we have brothers and sisters
in here today that never celebrated
Passover. So now they get a chance to
see the understanding come forth
straight out of the scriptures and
demonstrations and stuff like that
coming forth as the bishops are teaching
them. So that's that's the most thing
that I look forward to every year is
that understanding constantly coming
forth, bringing it back to our
remembrance.
